description: This header file declares the interface for an RPC client, including functions to initialize the RPC connection, retrieve the client instance, and check for connection loss. It also includes necessary headers and license information.
external_methods: rpc/rpc.h (provides rpc client functions and types)

methods.name: initRPC
methods.description: Initializes the RPC client with the specified IP address.

methods.name: getClientInstance
methods.description: Returns the current RPC client instance.

methods.name: isRPCConnectionLoss
methods.description: Checks if the RPC connection has been lost based on an error string.
